summary: Live re-run on a real psu Claude session (su-9e32c5b7, idle threshold 60 s) against the current psu-pty-host.mjs (blob a37a17e2, the WI-10006598 change included). Three parks each stopped the whole CLI tree; the two scanned parks found no survivors and no PAPERCUSP_SID holders. Presence stayed live and wakeable while parked. A keystroke resume and a coord-wake resume both reused native conversation f461ee99 and the sessions index holds exactly one Claude session for the owner. No session-end lifecycle row was written at any park; the real exit wrote one.
